front.title: End-to-End Session Tests for Media over QUIC Transport

abstract.t: This document describes a set of end-to-end tests that exercise a Media over QUIC Transport (MOQT) relay through real client sessions. For each test it gives a short description, the inputs, the message flow as a call-flow diagram, and the expected outcome. The tests apply to MOQT draft-18 and later; results for several public relays are published in the moq-web interop report.
